note: A large piano with horizontal strings and a lid that opens upward; includes concert grands and smaller baby grands.

senses.m: A large piano with horizontal strings and a lid that opens upward
senses.pat: play a grand piano · a concert grand piano · tune the grand piano
ex: The hall’s grand piano was tuned before the recital.
Đàn đại dương cầm trong hội trường được chỉnh dây trước buổi độc tấu.
They moved the grand piano carefully into the music room.
Họ cẩn thận chuyển cây đại dương cầm vào phòng nhạc.

note: A skirt made from grass or plant fibers, associated in popular imagery with some Pacific Island cultures; the term can oversimplify diverse traditions.

senses.m: A skirt made from grass or plant fibers, associated in popular imagery with some Pacific Island cultures
senses.pat: wear a grass skirt · a traditional grass skirt · grass-skirt costume
ex: The dance costume included a skirt made from woven plant fibers.
Trang phục múa có chiếc váy làm từ sợi thực vật đan.
The museum label explains the local name for the garment.
Nhãn bảo tàng giải thích tên gọi địa phương của trang phục.

note: A woman whose spouse is temporarily away; old-fashioned and chiefly British. In some regions it can mean a woman separated from her husband or an unmarried mother, so context matters.

senses.m: A woman whose spouse is temporarily away
senses.pat: a grass widow while her husband is away · the term grass widow
ex: The old novel calls her a grass widow while her husband works abroad.
Cuốn tiểu thuyết cũ gọi bà là người vợ phải sống xa chồng khi ông làm việc ở nước ngoài.
The expression is dated and may carry different meanings by region.
Cách nói này đã cũ và có thể mang nghĩa khác nhau tùy vùng.

note: A cross with four arms of equal length; common in some Christian architectural plans and heraldry.

senses.m: A cross with four arms of equal length
senses.pat: a Greek cross design · the arms of a Greek cross · Greek-cross plan
ex: The chapel was built around a Greek cross plan.
Nhà nguyện được xây theo mặt bằng hình chữ thập đều.
The emblem shows a red Greek cross on a white field.
Biểu tượng có hình chữ thập đỏ đều trên nền trắng.

note: A salad made mainly from leafy green vegetables, often with other ingredients and dressing.

senses.m: A salad made mainly from leafy green vegetables, often with other ingredients and dressing
senses.pat: serve a green salad · toss a green salad · mixed green salad
ex: They served a green salad with the soup.
Họ phục vụ salad rau xanh cùng món súp.
Add the dressing just before serving the green salad.
Chỉ thêm nước xốt ngay trước khi dọn salad rau xanh.

note: A situation or subject that is unclear, disputed, or not covered by clear rules; US spelling gray area.

senses.m: A situation or subject that is unclear, disputed, or not covered by clear rules
senses.pat: a legal grey area · fall into a grey area · the grey area between
ex: The policy leaves a grey area around temporary workers.
Chính sách để ngỏ một vùng chưa rõ ràng đối với lao động thời vụ.
The distinction between advice and instruction can be a grey area.
Ranh giới giữa lời khuyên và chỉ dẫn có thể không rõ ràng.

note: Food thrown into water to attract fish to a fishing spot; also groundbait.

senses.m: Food thrown into water to attract fish to a fishing spot
senses.pat: put out ground bait · use ground bait to attract fish · ground-bait mixture
ex: The anglers scattered ground bait near the reeds.
Những người câu rải mồi dụ cá gần đám sậy.
Too much ground bait can attract unwanted fish.
Quá nhiều mồi dụ có thể thu hút những loài cá không mong muốn.

note: The military forces that operate on land, as opposed to naval or air forces; exact organization varies.

senses.m: The military forces that operate on land, as opposed to naval or air forces
senses.pat: deploy ground forces · ground forces advance · army and ground forces
ex: The government said it would not deploy ground forces.
Chính phủ cho biết sẽ không triển khai lực lượng bộ binh.
Ground forces secured the road after the evacuation.
Lực lượng mặt đất kiểm soát con đường sau đợt sơ tán.

note: A person invited or permitted to work temporarily in a country where they are not a citizen; legal status and rights depend on the program.

senses.m: A person invited or permitted to work temporarily in a country where they are not a citizen
senses.pat: a guest-worker program · hire guest workers · guest-worker visa
ex: The factory hired guest workers under a temporary program.
Nhà máy tuyển lao động nước ngoài theo chương trình tạm thời.
The report examines housing conditions for guest workers.
Báo cáo khảo sát điều kiện nhà ở của lao động nước ngoài.

note: A dog trained to assist a blind or visually impaired person with safe navigation; also called a seeing-eye dog in some contexts.

senses.m: A dog trained to assist a blind or visually impaired person with safe navigation
senses.pat: train/use a guide dog · a guide-dog handler · guide dog access
ex: Her guide dog helped her cross the busy street.
Chó dẫn đường giúp cô băng qua con phố đông xe.
The guide dog waited quietly beside its handler.
Chó dẫn đường bình tĩnh chờ bên cạnh người điều khiển.

note: A tree that exudes gum or resin; in Australia it commonly refers to a eucalyptus. Meaning varies by region and species.

senses.m: A tree that exudes gum or resin
senses.pat: a eucalyptus gum tree · climb a gum tree · gum-tree leaves
ex: A koala rested in the branches of a gum tree.
Một con gấu koala nghỉ trên cành cây bạch đàn.
The term gum tree refers to different trees in different regions.
Từ gum tree chỉ các loài cây khác nhau ở các vùng khác nhau.

note: To block or make something sticky and difficult to operate; informal, often gum something up.

senses.m: To block or make something sticky and difficult to operate
senses.pat: gum up the works · gum up a mechanism · get gummed up
ex: Dust can gum up the printer mechanism.
Bụi có thể làm kẹt cơ cấu máy in.
A paperwork delay gummed up the approval process.
Việc chậm giấy tờ làm đình trệ quy trình phê duyệt.

note: A desperate last attempt; also a Roman Catholic prayer to Mary, usually capitalized as Hail Mary. In American football, a long, low-probability pass near the end of a game.

senses.m: A desperate last attempt
senses.pat: a Hail Mary pass · a Hail Mary attempt · say a Hail Mary
ex: With seconds left, the quarterback threw a Hail Mary.
Khi chỉ còn vài giây, tiền vệ ném một đường bóng cầu may.
The team made a last-ditch Hail Mary attempt to save the project.
Đội đưa ra một nỗ lực cuối cùng đầy may rủi để cứu dự án.

note: A clip or pin used to hold hair in place; British English. US equivalents include barrette or hair clip.

senses.m: A clip or pin used to hold hair in place
senses.pat: fasten hair with a hair slide · a decorative hair slide · put in a hair slide
ex: She used a hair slide to keep her fringe back.
Cô dùng kẹp tóc để giữ phần tóc mái ra sau.
The child chose a blue hair slide shaped like a flower.
Đứa trẻ chọn chiếc kẹp tóc màu xanh hình bông hoa.

note: A trigger that needs very little pressure to fire; figuratively, a person or situation that reacts extremely quickly.

senses.m: A trigger that needs very little pressure to fire
senses.pat: a hair-trigger mechanism · have a hair-trigger temper · hair-trigger response
ex: The rifle had a hair trigger and required careful handling.
Khẩu súng có cò cực nhạy nên cần được thao tác cẩn thận.
He has a hair-trigger temper when plans change.
Anh ấy rất dễ nổi nóng khi kế hoạch thay đổi.

note: A former British coin worth two shillings and sixpence, withdrawn before decimalization; also the sum it represented.

senses.m: A former British coin worth two shillings and sixpence, withdrawn before decimalization
senses.pat: a silver half crown · pay a half crown · pre-decimal half crown
ex: The collector found a half crown dated 1937.
Nhà sưu tầm tìm thấy đồng xu half crown có niên đại 1937.
The price was once listed as a half crown.
Giá từng được niêm yết là hai shilling sáu xu.

note: A US coin worth 50 cents.

senses.m: A US coin worth 50 cents
senses.pat: a Kennedy half dollar · pay with a half dollar · half-dollar coin
ex: He found a half dollar in the old drawer.
Anh tìm thấy đồng 50 xu trong ngăn kéo cũ.
The commemorative half dollar was issued for the anniversary.
Đồng 50 xu kỷ niệm được phát hành nhân dịp ngày lễ.

note: An institution or list honoring people who have excelled in a field; often capitalized as part of an official name.

senses.m: An institution or list honoring people who have excelled in a field
senses.pat: be inducted into a hall of fame · a sports hall of fame · Hall of Fame member
ex: She was inducted into the university’s hall of fame.
Cô được vinh danh trong đại sảnh danh vọng của trường đại học.
The museum’s Hall of Fame honors pioneering athletes.
Đại sảnh danh vọng của bảo tàng vinh danh các vận động viên tiên phong.

note: Bags a passenger carries into an aircraft cabin; airline size and weight limits vary. US English usually says carry-on baggage.

senses.m: Bags a passenger carries into an aircraft cabin
senses.pat: take hand luggage on board · hand-luggage allowance · a piece of hand luggage
ex: Passengers may take one small bag as hand luggage.
Hành khách có thể mang một túi nhỏ lên khoang hành khách.
Check the airline’s hand-luggage limits before packing.
Hãy kiểm tra giới hạn hành lý xách tay của hãng trước khi đóng gói.

note: A tool operated by hand rather than powered by an engine or electricity, such as a hammer or screwdriver.

senses.m: A tool operated by hand rather than powered by an engine or electricity, such as a hammer or screwdriver
senses.pat: use a hand tool · basic hand tools · hand-tool set
ex: A screwdriver is a common hand tool.
Tua vít là một dụng cụ cầm tay phổ biến.
Wear eye protection when using hand tools.
Hãy đeo kính bảo hộ khi sử dụng dụng cụ cầm tay.
